current_status.stage: Global Phase III (oral ASC30, AURORA-1/AURORA-2 pivotal trials, first participant dosed Aug 2026); ultra-long-acting SC depot formulation completed positive Phase II 24-week study; related amylin agonist ASC36 (once-monthly SC and oral) began Phase I Aug 2026
current_status.dosing_target: Once-daily oral (lead ASC30 program); once-monthly for SC depot formulation and for amylin agonist ASC36
current_status.data_point: Oral ASC30 Phase III (AURORA) targets ~4,600 patients, 72-week treatment, topline expected Q3 2028. SC depot Phase II (n=65, 24 weeks): Formulation A1 gave placebo-adjusted weight loss of 7.5% at week 16 and 5.8% at week 24 (4 months after last dose) with 3 monthly 400mg doses and no weekly lead-in.

finding_history.summary: Ascletis announced positive topline results from a U.S. Phase II, 24-week study of its ultra-long-acting subcutaneous depot formulations of ASC30 (a small-molecule GLP-1R agonist, not a peptide) for obesity. Formulation A1, given as three monthly 400mg doses with no weekly lead-in injections, produced placebo-adjusted weight loss of 6.3% at week 12, 7.5% at week 16, and durable 5.8% at week 24 (16 weeks after the last dose); Formulation A2 failed to achieve therapeutic exposure. No discontinuations due to adverse events were reported.

source.name: Ascletis press release via PR Newswire

finding_history.summary: Ascletis initiated two U.S. Phase I studies for ASC36 (a once-monthly, injectable amylin receptor peptide agonist discovered via its AI-assisted structure-based drug discovery platform) and ASC36_35FDC, a fixed-dose co-formulation of ASC36 with GLP-1R/GIPR dual agonist ASC35, following FDA IND clearance. Preclinical head-to-head DIO rat data showed ASC36 monotherapy produced ~91% and ~32% greater relative body-weight reduction than petrelintide and eloralintide, respectively.

source.name: Ascletis press release via PR Newswire

finding_history.summary: Ascletis announced dosing of the first participant in its global Phase III clinical program (two pivotal trials, AURORA-1 and AURORA-2) for once-daily oral small-molecule GLP-1 receptor agonist ASC30 in chronic weight management, enrolling ~4,600 adults with obesity/overweight (with and without type 2 diabetes) over 72 weeks. Topline data expected Q3 2028; U.S. NDA submission expected by end of 2028, EU MAA submission expected early 2029.

source.name: Ascletis press release via PR Newswire
